heroTitle: Give toward the work of the Diocese.
heroSubtext: Your generosity helps equip the Church for mission and raise up faithful Christian leaders across Aweil East.
introText: Equipping the Church for mission and raising up faithful Christian leaders. What you give, in whatever amount, goes directly toward that work: it does not pass through this website. Every gift, large or small, is received with gratitude and put to use across the Diocese's parishes and ministries.
